physical_memory_api_query: SELECT n.value AS name,COUNT(*) AS calls,SUM(c.endNs-c.startNs)/1e9 AS host_seconds FROM CANN_API c LEFT JOIN STRING_IDS n ON n.id=c.name WHERE n.value IN ('aclrtMallocPhysical','aclrtFreePhysical') GROUP BY n.value ORDER BY host_seconds DESC LIMIT 20
